**[@fig-pathway-analysis]** | **Functional pathway analysis across dementia transitions.** **A.** UpSet plot showing the intersection of genes associated with the top 1,000 CpG sites across different dementia transitions. The left bars show the total number of genes for each transition, while the vertical bars show the size of gene intersections, with connected dots below indicating which transitions contribute to each intersection. **B.** UpSet plot depicting the overlap of significantly enriched Gene Ontology (GO) terms across transitions. Similar to panel A, the left bars indicate total GO terms per transition, and vertical bars show the size of term intersections[; intersections of fewer than 5 terms are not shown, and parent terms whose genes were identical to those of a significant child term were removed (see Methods)]{.rev}. **C.** [Distribution of biological function categories among the GO terms significant in only one group, for each dementia transition. Terms were assigned to functional categories by keyword rules and counted by their redundancy-aware weights (see Methods); categories with a weighted count below two in a group are not shown.]{.rev} Bar heights represent the percentage of GO terms in each dementia transition for a functional category, with numbers above bars indicating the [weighted]{.rev} count of GO terms in that category.
